t: You're looking at St James's Church on Piccadilly, an Anglican church designed and built by Sir Christopher Wren. Wren is one of England's most acclaimed architects. He was responsible for rebuilding 52 City churches after the Great Fire, and St Paul's Cathedral is considered his masterpiece. Several people are buried here. The caricaturist James Gillray made famous political and social satires. The portrait painter Mary Beale was the main financial provider for her family. The marine painter Willem van de Velde the Younger lies here too. So do the physician and satirist John Arbuthnot and the composer and chess player François-André Philidor.
